Accounts payable receives the supplier invoice and matches it to the purchase order.

If the invoice does not match, accounts payable returns it to the supplier. If it matches, two checks run at the same time: the budget owner confirms the goods arrived, and the tax team checks the VAT. Once both checks are complete, accounts payable pays the invoice.
